narrative.overview: An artwork-led, task-focused library workspace. Real output covers supply the visual variety; controls stay compact, consistent and quiet. This records the current source implementation, not user-approved branding or rendered approval.
keyCharacteristics: Real artwork with explicit missing-image fallbacks.
Unframed sections, clear hierarchy and persistent operational feedback.
Equivalent light/dark surfaces and bilingual content.

rules.name: The Status Rule
rules.body: Never communicate artifact or job state by color alone.

dos: Do preserve real artwork proportions and reserve media dimensions.
Do use labels, keyboard focus and indeterminate partial-selection states.
Do keep long translated text and file paths inside their layout.
Do retain state and provide recovery during temporary failures.
donts: Don't invent artist portraits or playback features.
Don't use decorative hero sections or nested floating cards for operations.
Don't hide diagnostics or automatically replay rejected writes.
